sentences.en: Seaside resorts, such as Newport, are very crowded in summer.
sentences.zh: Newport 这样的海滨胜地在夏天非常拥挤。

sentences.en: The leisure industry is sinking more money into new resorts.
sentences.zh: 娱乐业正在投入更多资金建设新的度假村。

sentences.en: We should not resort to arms to settle international disputes.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该诉诸武力来解决国际争端。

senses.zh: 凭借，手段；常去之地；度假胜地 -
求助，诉诸；采取某手段或方法；常去
